description: Core, verifiable facts for active Indian credit cards — fees, eligibility, reward rates, point values and quantified perks. Independent, no paid placements. Free to cite with attribution.
citation: CardAdvisor — India Credit Card Facts Dataset, https://cardadvisor.in/data (as of 2026-08-07).

fieldDictionary.cardKey: Stable slug; the card detail page is /cards/{cardKey}.
fieldDictionary.name: Official card name.
fieldDictionary.annualFeeRs: Recurring annual fee in ₹ (0 if none).
fieldDictionary.joiningFeeRs: One-time joining fee in ₹ (0 if none).
fieldDictionary.lifetimeFree: True only if genuinely no annual fee AND no spend-based waiver condition.
fieldDictionary.feeWaiverSpendRs: Annual spend in ₹ that waives the annual fee; null if not waivable.
fieldDictionary.forexMarkupPct: Foreign-currency markup as a percentage (before 18% GST); null if unpublished.
fieldDictionary.aprMonthlyPct: Monthly finance charge (APR) as a percentage; null if unpublished.
fieldDictionary.minSalaryRs: Stated minimum monthly income in ₹; null if unpublished.
fieldDictionary.minAgeYears: Minimum applicant age; null if unpublished.
fieldDictionary.maxAgeYears: Maximum applicant age; null if unpublished.
fieldDictionary.rewardRateMinPct: Base earn rate as a % of spend (real cash value, excludes portal accelerators).
fieldDictionary.rewardRateMaxPct: Best category earn rate as a % of spend (real cash value, excludes portal accelerators).
fieldDictionary.welcomeBonusValueRs: Estimated ₹ value of the first-year welcome/joining bonus; null if none.
fieldDictionary.expertRating: CardAdvisor editorial rating out of 5; null if unrated.
fieldDictionary.lastVerified: Date this card record was last verified against issuer sources (yyyy-mm-dd).
fieldDictionary.rewards: Per-category earn rows: category, rewardType, ratePct (EFFECTIVE cash return as a % of spend, i.e. points-per-₹1 × pointValuePaisa — directly comparable across points and cashback cards), monthlyCapRs, pointValuePaisa, merchants (scope; portal/co-brand rows are marked).
